page.content:
Lumar (Persian: لومار) is a city in the Central District of Sirvan County, Ilam province, Iran, serving as capital of both the county and the district. It is also the administrative center for Lumar Rural District.

page.overview:
What is Lumar?

Lumar (Persian: لومار) is a city in the Central District of Sirvan County, Ilam province, Iran, serving as capital of both the county and the district. It is also the administrative center for Lumar Rural District.
